steps.title: Pinned versions and imports
steps.markdown: The script targets trl 1.16.0, transformers 5.20.2, peft 0.21.2 and datasets 5.1.0 on a free Colab T4. It needs a GPU. `GRPOConfig` holds the knobs; `GRPOTrainer` runs the loop.

steps.title: Model and instructions
steps.markdown: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct is small enough to train on a T4. The system prompt asks for thinking inside `<think>` tags and only the final number inside `<answer>` tags, the format our reward checks.

steps.title: Parsing helpers
steps.markdown: Same rules as `rewards.py` from the rewards lab. `completion_text` handles both plain strings and chat messages, `parse_number` takes the last number and ignores commas, and `is_correct` compares the number inside `<answer>` with the number after `####` in GSM8K's solution.

steps.title: Two reward functions
steps.markdown: TRL calls each reward with `completions` plus dataset columns as keyword arguments (here `answer`) and expects one float per completion. Format pays 0.5, correctness pays 1.0; TRL adds them and logs each separately.

steps.title: Turning GSM8K into chats
steps.markdown: Each question becomes a `prompt` column in chat format (system + user). The original `answer` column is kept, so the correctness reward can read it.

steps.title: GRPOConfig: the equation as settings
steps.markdown: Batch sizes count completions: 8 per micro-batch x 2 accumulation steps = 16 = 2 questions x a group of 8. `beta`, `epsilon`, `epsilon_high`, `loss_type` and `scale_rewards` are the symbols from the GRPO equation. `fp16=True` with float32 weights because a T4 has no fast bfloat16.

steps.title: LoRA adapters and the trainer
steps.markdown: LoRA freezes the base model and trains small adapters on the attention and MLP projections. With a PEFT model, TRL gets reference probabilities by switching the adapter off, so the KL term costs almost no memory. `save_model` writes just the adapter.

steps.title: Loading a model for evaluation
steps.markdown: Load the base model in fp16 on the GPU with left padding (needed for batched generation). If an adapter folder is given, attach it and merge it into the weights.

steps.title: Held-out evaluation
steps.markdown: Ask the first `n` GSM8K test questions, which training never sees, with greedy decoding so results are repeatable. Report accuracy and the share of answers in the requested format.

steps.title: Command line
steps.markdown: `--eval-only` scores the untrained model (your baseline). Without it, the script trains for `--max-steps` steps and then scores the trained adapter.
